notes.title: The second playtest is available!
notes.content:
Lots of new stuff and fixes were done since the first playtest. The most of visual changes happened in town scenes:
1. They finally contains something to explore.
2. You can interact with NPCs (buy stuff, heal, etc). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40894186/a7a517656ab9b9c16c21b01bde0f56d42110db96.png[/img]

The rest of the game has changed too:
1. A couple of new enemies.
2. New weapons.
3. Town icons on the world map hint what kind of NPCs are waiting for you there.
4. Added minimap and map to help wandering in dungeons.
5. Tweaks and fixes for controls.
And tons of other fixes.

notes.title: The first playtest build with in-game feedback.
notes.content:
Update 20210718:
* Added a button to trigger the feedback popup from any scene.
* Automatically trigger the feedback popup when all types of scenes were visited by the character.
* The feedback popup allows the player to go to game's discussions in Steam, to Google form with questions about the playtest experience or to write a short message without leaving the game.

notes.title: The first playtest is available!
notes.content:
I'm really glad to open the first RATOMON playtest and finally show something playable to everyone interested.
There is nothing fancy, just a couple of towns to clear. It's mostly a test of the playtest mechanics itself. So if you expect a diversity explosion, please be patient.) Have fun and please report any feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40894186/85e55bbf9af4097a8219879aa3aa53bcf6adc71e.png[/img]

If you are interested in the next playtest, you can sign up anytime. I plan to upload new versions every week, but that's not carved in stone.
